title: Eye of Horus II Pendant, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Mystical decorations alluding to ancient Egypt Finest silver plated with 24-karat gold Gold-plated catch, so you can turn your coin into a stylish piece of jewelry This extraordinary pendant embodies strength, health, and divine protection, inspired by the rich heritage of ancient Egypt. Combining elegance with symbolism, it serves as a timeless talisman for those seeking balance, confidence, and positive energy in their lives.
